problem:
The $13$th root of unity ${e}^{22\pi \text{i}/13}$ can be written as 

$$
{e}^{22\pi \text{i}/13}={z}^{p},
$$

where $z$ is the principal $13$th root of unity. What is the value of $p?$

$p=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
Recall that the $13$th roots of unity can be written in the form

$$
{e}^{2k\pi \text{i}/13}
$$

where $k=0,1,…,12.$ 

We obtain the *principal* $13$th root of unity by substituting $k=1:$

$$
z={e}^{2\cdot 1\cdot \pi \text{i}/13}={e}^{2\pi \text{i}/13}
$$

We can write the given root of unity as a power of the principal root as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{e}^{22\pi \text{i}/13} & =({e}^{2\pi \text{i}/13})^{11}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $p=11.$
